about.body: I'm a software engineer who enjoys working across the whole stack, from small packages and APIs to full web and mobile apps. Cybersecurity is my other big interest, and I'm usually testing out some new framework or tool just to see what it's good for. Most of what I build is meant to make something in someone's day a little easier.
